text: The Civic Appointments Committee must select candidates to be interviewed for appointment to the Toronto and Region Conservation Authority. The Civic Appointments Committee will conduct interviews at an upcoming meeting and recommend four candidates to City Council.

The Civic Appointments Committee: 1. Selected the following candidates for interview at its next meeting for appointment to the Toronto and Region Conservation Authority: TRC2-63 TRC2-74 TRC2-75 TRC2-89 TRC2-91 TRC2-96 TRC2-113 TRC2-115 2. Directed that Confidential Attachments 1 and 2 to the report (October 30, 2023) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relates to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Toronto and Region Conservation Authority.
